restrictions: C39 PB=0 ordinary-collision construction for sha256-r39-prefix-v1 only. Every trial uses a fresh random 64-byte first block and A0, completely enumerates prefix outputs, uniformly reservoir-selects one output when nonempty, and verifies that output with two complete second-block compressions.

The run contains N=1756406089356818651915999597 ideal fresh trial slots and stops before exceeding 8*64*N target units. Preprocessing separately charges 2^74 target units and all finite construction/evidence work.

The 0.39 claim is exploratory and conditional on H1 selected matching-class transfer and nominal tail coverage, H3 upper-advice and native-SAT construction within 2^74, and H4 complete mean work at most 64 units. The exact selected-output identity needs no sibling-independence, output-cap, or retained-successful-mass premise.

Complete memory is 22 GiB. It covers the 17 GiB+4-byte resident inverse table, 18 GiB+4-byte table-build arrays, fixed parameters, allocator, code, stacks, counters, output workspace and retained randomness.

heuristics.statement: The fresh selected-prefix SIS block mean applies to the actual uniformly selected output of a nonempty real-H trial, and the nominal one-sided block-bootstrap endpoint lower-bounds that mean.
heuristics.scope: The fixed C39 core, j=adc6d187, list 5532657e..., complete PB=0 enumeration and uniform one-output reservoir rule.
heuristics.extrapolation: The first 64 selected outputs from the fresh 2^24-trial campaign are sampled in trial order. Each receives the unchanged 512-path matching-class tail estimator. Their nominal endpoint is combined with the exact binomial nonempty endpoint.
heuristics.limitations: The inverse tail sampler varies the matching-class chaining value. Selection may correlate with unobserved matching coordinates. The block bootstrap has no proved rare-event coverage theorem; its distribution-free lower endpoint is zero; deterministic seeds are not ideal coins.

heuristics.statement: For a complete fresh trial, P(success)=P(X>0)*P(the uniform reservoir output succeeds | X>0). Independent ideal fresh trials amplify this selected event.
heuristics.scope: Complete PB=0 enumeration, one-item reservoir sampling and the fixed global work cap.
heuristics.extrapolation: The 2^24 fresh campaign observed 406 nonempty trials and independently replayed all 450 outputs and all 406 choices. Exact reservoir induction replaces the rejected expected-sibling conversion.
heuristics.limitations: The binomial endpoint assumes ideal independent trials. Fixed public PRNG seeds only reproduce the evidence. The 16-attempt rejection failure is explicitly bounded below 2^-664 over the full nominal run.

heuristics.statement: Complete expected online work is at most 64 target units per fresh trial and the measured branch rates transfer to the full ideal run.
